title: Handle unavailable pending publish destination paths
summary: Preserve the backend-authored pending-publish destination when a read-only existence probe fails for an unavailable network path.
reason: Hosted Windows release validation reproduced WinError 64 while evaluating an unavailable UNC destination, causing a read-only pending-publish policy test and release self-test to fail.
behavior_before: An OSError from Path.exists propagated while deriving the destination folder for the pending-publish open action.
behavior_after: Existence-probe OSErrors preserve the manifest/backend-authored destination folder; no publish, drain, manifest, or filesystem mutation behavior changes.
manual_validation: Bundled-Python release CI provisioning suite: 7 passed.
Ruff on the changed source and test: passed.
Release self-test with tool-integration and end-to-end skips: passed after canonical generated inventory refresh.
rollback_plan: Revert the OSError fallback and its regression test; this restores propagation of network existence-probe failures.
notes:
Read-only open-path derivation only. The pending-publish mutation boundary and its real-media drain gate are not changed.
Handle unavailable UNC existence probes without changing the backend-authored open destination.
Add deterministic unavailable-network regression coverage.
Document the scoped pending-publish robustness fix and validation.
Refresh the canonical generated source summary.
Regenerate the canonical test-definition inventory after adding the regression test.
